tools.name: get_system_time
tools.description: Read the current local system date and time.
tools.description_zh: 读取 Windows 当前本地时间。

tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Get weather for the configured default location, or use location_id returned by search_location. view=current, hourly, or daily.
tools.description_zh: 查询默认地点或已搜索地点的当前、逐小时、每日天气。
agent_hints: For a named location, call search_location first and pass its returned location_id to get_weather. Never invent location_id.

location_id.description: Optional location ID returned by search_location.

view.description: Weather time range. Defaults to current.

fields.description: Optional fields for hourly or daily results.

hours.description: Number of future hours for hourly view. Defaults to 24.

forecast_days.description: Number of days for daily view. Defaults to 3.
